title: EU Commission ‘confident’ that Bulgaria, Czech Republic, Hungary, and Slovakia will join new €45bn Ukraine loan
lede: The EU Commission has come up with a new financing plan to fill Ukraine's €70bn funding gap next year, and thinks it has found a way to convince member states who want to opt-out by clearly separating civilian from military spending

title: EU ‘sustainable’ defence note did not drive flows, says Czech National Bank
lede: Researchers find ESG-focused investors targeted by 2025 European Commission notice did not subsequently increase defence holdings.
